image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a large whale's head and upper torso. The skin is mottled grey with significant white/orange patching (barnacles/lice) on the rostrum. The eye is visible, and the mouth line curves gently. The background is murky blue water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a side-profile close-up; the top of the head where blowholes are located is not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture clearly shows the characteristic mottling and heavy encrustation of barnacles/lice on the snout, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only shows the anterior portion of the whale; the dorsal area is outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and shoulder region are visible; the full body shape cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; the visible skin exhibits the correct coloration and texture patterns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed, so the baleen plates inside the oral cavity are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pectoral fins are located further back on the body and are not included in this tight crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The high-resolution detail on the snout confirms the rough, bumpy texture associated with callosities and barnacle clusters.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The eye appears slightly 'swirled' or painterly rather than having a distinct pupil/cornea reflection typical of real photography. The transition between the barnacle textures and the smooth skin on the lower jaw has slight smudging/bleeding.
The background is uniformly smooth and lacks the particulate matter or light scattering variance usually seen in underwater photography, suggesting a generated backdrop.
